'''Fudbalski klub Borac 1926''' ({{Lang-sr-Cyrl|Фудбалски клуб Борац 1926}}), commonly known as '''Borac Čačak''', is a professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Čačak]], Serbia. The home ground is [[Čačak Stadium]], which has seating capacity of 8,000. As of 2024–25 season, the club competes in second tier [[Serbian First League]].

The word Borac in translation means ''fighter'' in English. Mainly because of the horizontal stripes, Borac's nickname is "Zebras"."}}
